propPlay.writeup: Tiffany Hayes has cleared 5+ points in 82% of her 45 games this season, and is riding a 19-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 100% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 9.1 points on the season (10.6 across her last 5) — the 5+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -450 at Fanatics.
